name: Darth Plagueis's starship
description: A starship was owned by the Muun Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Plagueis in the years before his death in 32 BBY. He flew it with his personal droid 11-4D and used it for missions to places such as Abraxin and Naboo on missions to find Naat Lare and to kill Ars Veruna respectively.
